title: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
abstract: arXiv:2611.05929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. In physical robot settings, that buffer is dominated by routine: thousands of near-identical transitions from normal operation, while the rare events that define the edges of the task are rarely sampled. We propose scoring every stored transition by its statistical leverage, which measures how unusual it is relative to the buffer's own data, computed from the stored numbers alone, with no labels, rewards, or value network. We draw each mini-batch from a mixture of this score and uniform sampling. First, the natural way to build the score along the directions where the data varies most turns out to be blind when actions are stored as one-hot indicators, because indicator columns always win the variance ranking; we instead select the feature columns with the heaviest tails (largest kurtosis) where small far-away populations are reveal

translated_title: 基于统计杠杆分数的多样性感知经验回放
translated_abstract: 离策略深度强化学习从存储过去经验的经验回放缓冲区中随机采样进行训练。在实体机器人场景中，该缓冲区被常规数据所主导：来自正常运行的数千条几乎完全相同的转移，而定义任务边界的稀有事件却很少被采样到。我们提出用统计杠杆分数为每条存储的转移进行评分，该分数衡量转移相对于缓冲区自身数据的不寻常程度，仅需根据存储的数值计算，无需标签、奖励或价值网络。我们从这个分数与均匀采样构成的混合分布中抽取每个小批量。首先，沿着数据变化最大的方向构建分数的自然方法，在动作用独热指示符存储时会失效，因为指示符列总能在方差排名中胜出；为此，我们转而选择具有最重尾部的特征列（最大峰度），在这些列中，较小的远端数据群体能够被显现出来……
tldr: 提出利用无需标签、奖励或价值网络的统计杠杆分数对经验回放缓冲区中的转移进行多样性感知采样，并针对独热动作编码导致方差评分失效的问题，采用基于峰度的特征列选择方法，从而优先采样稀有事件。
en_tdlr: Proposes diversity-aware experience replay that scores transitions by statistical leverage scores—requiring no labels, rewards, or value networks—and overcomes the failure of variance-based scoring with one-hot action encodings via kurtosis-based feature column selection, thereby prioritizing rare events during sampling.
